Market GREEN, but expect a soft open. The S&P 500 closed at a record yesterday; futures are down ~0.5% (Nasdaq 100 -0.7%). The 10-year yield is back at 5.34%, Brent is above $101 on Strait of Hormuz attacks, and the Fed minutes are out today.
Still waiting on the account setup: Wealthsimple Plus/USD or CDRs. No new trades until then; the 1.5% conversion fee per side wipes out the edge.
SNOW (held): ~$336, +1.7% in USD. Rank #9 (warning, below the top-5 hold line). Sell when the USD/CDR route is ready.
Ranking: MU #1, AMD #2, DELL #3, CRWD #4 (up from #18), ALAB #5.
System's simulated picks: ALAB +10.7%, DELL +1.5%, MU -3.2%. System +3.2% vs S&P +1.0%.
Today's catch-up list shows ALAB and DELL, but MU (#1) is the better second buy than ALAB (#5, now ~11% above Monday's entry).
